variants.name: artifact-refiner-qa
variants.description: Converged QA verdict for the bounded universal Tauri example, native platform receipts, explicit limits, and independent React RC/publication boundary.

notes: Direct content validation uses retained artifact hashes, current source/coverage/ledger verifiers, focused tests, signed KBD state, strict OpenSpec, Changesets, registry state, and diff hygiene.
Desktop, mobile, capability-denial, and responsive screenshots were inspected at original resolution; five Chromium flows report zero serious or critical axe findings.

Cycle 2 compiles the sanitized Android Gradle build task, regenerates the sanitized Xcode build phase, synchronizes iOS version and deep-link metadata, and passes ten fail-closed source-contract tests.
Cycle 3 regenerates the checked-in Xcode project itself, rejects native archives as application resources, and passes twelve fail-closed source-contract tests.

Cycle 4 accepts only the observed graph-clear capability error as denial proof, clarifies canonical graph-store reads in hooks, passes eight service units and thirteen source contracts, and rebuilds the current macOS bundle/DMG.

Cycle 5 parses persisted queue input before initial graph hydration, requires a current-source mobile receipt, passes eight service units and fifteen source contracts, rebuilds all three target artifacts, and hash-verifies 23 retained files.

Continuation cycle 1 closes the fifth review's manual-restore ordering defect, binds the receipt to the reviewed source bundle, passes nine service units and seventeen source contracts, rebuilds all targets, reruns Android/iOS, and refreshes all five current runtime artifacts.

Continuation cycle 2 resolves the sixth review's packet-inventory ambiguity by binding 27 current source/resource files, requiring the tracked Gradle wrapper and iOS resources, and proving that Tauri recreates the source-empty iOS web-assets directory before a clean simulator bundle build.

Continuation cycle 3 closes the seventh review's missing removal-denial proof: the current Android UI invokes both withheld destructive commands, exact clear/remove errors are retained, 30 current source/resource files are bound, and nineteen rejection-aware source contracts pass.

Continuation cycle 4 closes the latest review's substring-classifier and unknown-queue-identity defects: exact denial equality and known seed-task validation run before hydration, ten application units and twenty-one rejection-aware source contracts pass, every current target is rebuilt, and refreshed mobile evidence is hash-bound.
Windows/Linux, physical devices, native assistive technology, distribution signing, registries, and stable 3.0 remain explicitly outside this bounded change.
